historical_references.reference: Sarabjeet Singh was a highly decorated military officer in the Indian Army, who was posthumously awarded the Param Vir Chakra, India's highest military decoration, for his actions during the 1971 Indo-Pakistan War.

Sarabjeet Singh was an influential figure in the Sikh community in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. He was a prominent leader during the Ghadar Movement, a rebellion against British rule in India, and was also a key figure in the establishment of the Ghadar Party.
